brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: A tidy place to keep sewing supplies: a storage unit built from a hex base with a bin for the supplies.
requirements.evidence: One hex base (piece, full) at the origin cell with a full-depth bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3) dropped into it. The build is a single-cell tray unit.

requirements.requirement: The supplies are kept apart in separate compartments so small items do not mix (bin with 3 compartments).
requirements.evidence: The bin is the 'Bin, full depth, 3 compartments' variant (hex-bin-full-div3), and the BOM lists it under that name. check_build is clear. However my BOM text test ('3 compartments') sees 0 matches and the test could not be changed after building, so the automated check does not confirm it. Treat the compartment count as shown by the part name, not by the test.

finish.summary: Built a small storage unit for sewing supplies: one full hex base holding a full-depth bin with three compartments. Check is clear (no mesh clashes, no errors). The one open item is that my automated BOM text test for the 3-compartment requirement did not match the part, so R2 is marked partial; the part itself is the 3-compartment bin.
